name: Alexis Jarre
headline: Turning Linkedin into Revenue | Co-founder @NaanoX

posts.text:
Recently for Naano.com, I had a sales call with someone that told me influence just doesn't work for them.

I asked him why. He said we tried it. 
Lots of reactions and views but almost no conversion.

Turns out the posts were fine. 
Good creators. Good engagement.

But after the post? 
Nothing. No outreach. No follow-up.

So I asked him what he did with everyone who liked and commented.
He said nothing.

That's the whole problem. 
Those people raised their hand. They were warm. 
And nobody talked to them.

Post is the beginning of the work. 
You still have to go talk to the people who engaged. 
That's where the clients are.

Deel is looking for LinkedIn creators to promote them.

They give founders and growing teams one platform to hire, pay, and manage people anywhere in the world.

They want creators to talk about it in their own words.

Here's what they're looking for (mandatory):
 → Only UK, US, Canadian creators
 → 15k followers minimum (and above)
 → Business owners or tech creators
 → Paid between $250 and $1,500 depending on your number of followers and engagement.

If you fit with the criteria we will send you the link to apply ;)

We finally paid for a real domain.

naano.XYZ is over.
naano.COM is live.

Turns out a ".com" costs more than a coffee. 👀
Honestly, the price made us hesitate.

But if we didn't buy it now, someone else would.
And they'd sell it back to us for a fortune.
So we paid decided to invest. 

Looks better no ?! 
⭐ NAANOX.COM ⭐

Deel is recruiting LinkedIn creators to promote them.

They give founders and growing teams one platform to hire, pay, and manage people anywhere in the world.

They want creators to talk about it in their own words.

Here's what they're looking for (mandatory):
 → Only UK, US, Canadian creators
 → 15k followers minimum
 → Business owners or tech creators

Drop a comment below and if you fit with the criteria we will send you the link to apply ;)

During my meetings for NaanoX, I heard that a lot :

"We'd rather run our LinkedIn influence in-house."
"Why would we pay for a platform?"

On paper, it sounds cheaper. 

BUT

You DM 20 creators, you wait 3 days for 2 replies. 
You negotiate rates, chase contracts.
Follow up with the creators to ask them to post in time.  
You build a spreadsheet to keep track of it all.

At scale, it's just impossible. 
Here's what it looks like with NaanoX instead.

You launch your campaign in 10 minutes. 
24 hours later you've got 30 applications waiting or you are matched with them with our NaanoX algorithm. 

You don't even have to source creators, handle creators payment, and analyse the campaign. 

It's a no-brainer 🤷‍♂️

sections.bio:
A few months ago, I was creating LinkedIn content for Pletor.
 
I grew from 1,500 to 5,000 followers in 40 days, and generated 3,000+ MQLs for them in 2 months.
 
Just with LinkedIn content. 
 
And then it hit me: why isn't there a structured way for companies to tap into creators like me. 
People with real expertise, real audiences, and real credibility without the guesswork of traditional influencer deals?
 
So, we decided to build NaanoX.
 
Naano is a marketplace that connects B2B tech companies looking to scale their growth with LinkedIn creators looking to monetize their audience.
 
The results so far?
 
2000 creators live on the platform
30 companies onboarded across AI, Sales, GTM, CRM and Finance.
 
If you're a B2B tech company tired of cold outbound and overpriced ads → let's talk. 
If you're a LinkedIn creator (1K–30K followers) ready to monetize your audience → naano.xyz/creators
